claims.statement: Regulation (EU) 2024/573 requires specified F-gas equipment to receive periodic leak checks by certified people and prescribes check frequency by gas quantity and detection system.
Article 7 requires per-equipment records covering gas quantities, service parties and certificates, check and repair results, and decommissioning, generally retained for at least five years.

contrary_evidence: Poland already has official certification and equipment-register processes.
Field-service software can add F-gas forms, and low-charge equipment may not trigger leak-check duties.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: a cross-firm asset history and recurring-fault map tied to verified service credentials
fingerprint.customer: HVAC and heat-pump wholesalers, certified service firms, and equipment operators
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: wholesaler counters, training centres, certification bodies, and renewable-installation networks
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: offline-first field capture, credential verification, due-date scheduling, gas chain-of-custody, and dual-party records
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: wholesalers pay for the network layer and contractors pay per technician and service event
fingerprint.problem_trigger: equipment is sold, installed, serviced, leak-checked, charged, repaired, or decommissioned

founder_fit: Direct family renewable-installation access enables a lawful pilot; the product combines operational automation with low-cost, partner-led distribution.
risks: Duplicate entry with official systems can kill adoption.
Offline field errors can create false records.

structure.control_point: the credential-verified service event and equipment record accepted by operator, contractor, and inspector
structure.critical_dependency: installer adoption and reliable interoperability with certification and national equipment-register data

thesis: A wholesaler-sponsored ledger can bind certified people and firms to each heat-pump or refrigeration asset, schedule leak checks, capture gas movements and repairs at the field edge, and hand both operator and contractor the required history. The wholesaler acquires many installers; every sale, visit, leak check, recovery, and decommissioning is a repeat event.
title: F-Gas Credential and Asset-Service Ledger for HVAC Wholesalers
uncertainties: Wholesaler willingness to sponsor competitors on one network.
